paragraphs.text: Jadzi was a human wizard who acted as the Oracle of Arcavios .

Jadzi was the wisest, most powerful, and most accomplished mage on Arcavios. The Oracle's lifelong task is to ensure that magic is used to help people and not twisted to evil ends. To be the Oracle, one must understand fundamental truths about the nature of magic, know and wield hundreds or thousands of spells, and possess impeccable judgment and virtue. Jadzi specialized in substance manipulation. Jadzi was a charming, wrinkled old lady who always smiled and had an incredible memory. She specialized in substance manipulation and could hover in the air.

She was highly attuned to slight shifts in the underlying mana currents of the plane, able to predict the formation of new snarls and star arches. It was said that she knew the location of every star arch on Arcavios. For most of the Archaics , she knew which Oracle they once were. It was also said that she could find anyone on Arcavios simply through listening to the mana and converse with Archaics despite their strange ways of speaking. She harbored a quiet guilt that she was unable to predict and protect the plane more from the Phyrexian Invasion , and in its wake she spent much of her time wandering the plane, repairing the damage done to Arcavios during the invasion.
Jadzi attended Strixhaven University, likely studying at Quandrix College. She graduated decades before 4565 AR and became the Oracle of Arcavios by 4561.

During the fall semester of 4565, she was abducted by the Dawning Archaic . It brought her to a chamber underneath Titan's Grave containing a nexus of wild energy, where she tried to discern the reason for its rampage. However, her ritual to calm the Archaic was disrupted by Chandra Nalaar trying to kill it, and while attempting to calm it again, the Quandrix mage-student Tamira pushed her into the nexus, causing her to disappear from reality.

Upon her arrival in Hexhaven in the Echoverse , Jadzi was imprisoned by The Theorist . An understanding of her nature was essential to his plans to overlay the Echoverse onto the original Multiverse. The oracles of Arcavios are unique, as they are tied to the origin of their home plane. When they die, their soul is projected to the source, through any planar and temporal barrier, where they become Archaics . The Theorist aimed to witness Jadzi's consciousness return to the beginning of time, where the original planes Ezroi and Karudis fused into a single new one. With this knowledge, he could make the Echoverse overlay a reality. However, Jadzi had to be killed to make this possible.

The Theorist repeatedly visited Jadzi's cell, but could never work up the nerve to kill her. He attributed this to weaknesses in his mind and tried to telepathically excise them. Meanwhile, Jadzi used her oracular abilities to study the Theorist and the possible outcomes of her imprisonment, taunting him for his deficiencies whenever he visited her. Eventually, impelled by the impending threat of planeswalkers from the original Multiverse that had come to stop him, he had her brought to his sanctum, determined to carry out his plan. Only then did he come to the realization that he was no longer capable of it, having pared his courage away from him long ago. Jadzi, however, recognized this outcome from her visions. With apparent conviction, she grabbed his knife and used it to kill herself, allowing him to witness the birth of Arcavios and carry out his grand design.
